description: The Desk’s open sure-win pairs (GET desk/arbitrage): two bets on the two sides of the same bet at the same line at two different books whose prices together pay more than was staked whichever side wins (0.05% or more; a Kalshi side is sized after its fee). Each pair: {id, kind: "arbitrage", league, matchup, startAt, profitPct, total, profit, bets: [two of {label, book, oddsAmerican, afterFee, stakePct, stake, payout, link, linkKind ("bet" | "game" | null), linkNeedsState, linkMarket (Kalshi side only: {ticker, side, title}, else null)}], firstSeenAt, checkedAt}. stake splits `total` dollars (default 100) so both results pay the same; profit is the smaller result minus the total. Prices move: checkedAt is when the engine last saw the pair. Desk plan and up; Free, Starter and Pro get locked rows. Reads only: this never places a bet.

total.description: Dollars to split across the two bets of each arbitrage pair (default 100).
